card.line: Colossae was a city in Phrygia where a church of faithful believers met, and Paul wrote one of his letters to them.

moments.title: Paul writes to Colossae
moments.text: Paul and Timothy send greetings to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae. They wish them grace and peace from God our Father.

moments.title: Thanks for their faith and love
moments.text: Paul and Timothy thank God when they pray for the Colossians. They have heard of their faith in Christ Jesus and their love for all the saints.

moments.title: Epaphras brings the gospel
moments.text: The Colossians learned the gospel from Epaphras, a faithful minister of Christ. He also told Paul about their love in the Spirit.
